```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(caret)
```


```{r}
# Load the cleaned team-match dataset
local_path <- "processed_data/soccer_model_features.csv"

# GitHub fallback
github_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/",
  "kevinhav/d621/main/final/processed_data/",
  "soccer_team_match_2017_18.csv"
)

model_data <- read_csv(
  if (file.exists(local_path)) local_path else github_url,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Select features for modeling
model_data_slice <- model_data |>
  dplyr::select(-(match_date:opponent_name), -passes_per_shot) |>
  mutate(home = as.factor(home))
```

```{r}
# Split data into test and training sets
set.seed(7284)

match_ids  <- unique(model_data_slice$match_id)
train_ids  <- sample(match_ids, size = 0.8 * length(match_ids))

train <- model_data_slice |> filter(match_id %in% train_ids)
test  <- model_data_slice |> filter(!match_id %in% train_ids)

# Check that both test and train have both teams from each match
nrow(train) / n_distinct(train$match_id)
nrow(test) / n_distinct(test$match_id)
```

```{r}
# Shift data and check for Box Cox transformations
num_data_train <- train |>
  dplyr::select(where(is.numeric), -goals, -match_id)

# Shift data that has values at or below 0.
shift_amt <- sapply(num_data_train, \(x) {
  m <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (m <= 0) 1 - m else 0
})

# View which columns will get shifted.
shift_amt[shift_amt > 0] |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  `rownames<-`("") |>
  kable()

# Function that adds the stored shift to each column.
apply_shift <- function(df, shifts) {
  for (col in names(shifts)) df[[col]] <- df[[col]] + shifts[[col]]
  df
}

# Apply the shift, then apply Box-Cox, center, and scale.
num_shifted_train <- apply_shift(num_data_train, shift_amt) |> as.data.frame()

pp <- preProcess(num_shifted_train, method = c("BoxCox", "center", "scale"))
lambdas <- sapply(pp$bc, \(x) x$lambda)
lambdas

train_pp <- predict(pp, num_shifted_train)
train_pp <- train_pp |> cbind(train |> dplyr::select(!where(is.numeric), goals))

# Apply same shift and pre-processing to test data.
test_shifted <- apply_shift(test |> dplyr::select(all_of(names(num_data_train))), shift_amt)
test_pp <- predict(pp, as.data.frame(test_shifted))
test_pp <- test_pp |> cbind(test |> dplyr::select(!where(is.numeric), goals))
```

```{r}
train_pp |>
  mutate(goals_plus_one = goals + 1) |>
  dplyr::select(goals_plus_one) |>
  preProcess(method = c("BoxCox"))

train_pp <- train_pp |>
  mutate(log_goals_plus_one = log(goals + 1))

test_pp <- test_pp |>
  mutate(log_goals_plus_one = log(goals + 1))

train_pp |>
  pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "#3a86d4", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count", title = "Variable Distributions") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.6)
```

```{r}
# Model 1: Linear Regression w/ Opponent
lm_1 = lm(goals ~ . - log_goals_plus_one, train_pp)
summary(lm_1)

# Model 2: Linear Regression w/o Opponent
lm_2 = lm(goals ~ . - log_goals_plus_one - opponent_shots - opponent_passes
          - opponent_pass_accuracy_pct, train_pp)
summary(lm_2)

# Model 3: Linear Regression on Log Goals w/ Opponent
lm_3 = lm(log_goals_plus_one ~ . - goals, train_pp)
summary(lm_3)

# Model 4: Linear Regression on Log Goals w/ Opponent
lm_4 = lm(log_goals_plus_one ~ . - goals - opponent_shots - opponent_passes
          - opponent_pass_accuracy_pct, train_pp)
summary(lm_4)
```
